title: Agile Project Management
overview: This course is designed to equip participants with the skills necessary for managing knowledge-based projects using agile methodologies. Through interactive sessions, participants will learn essential tools and techniques for agile project management, which are crucial for passing the PMI-ACP® (Agile Certified Practitioner) certification exam
audience: This course is intended for individuals seeking in-depth knowledge of agile project management. It is also suitable for those aiming to understand the practices, tools, and techniques needed to effectively manage changes within the agile framework.
methodology: The course employs individual and group exercises to teach key agile project management activities. It also includes case studies, participant presentations, and group discussions, along with pre- and post-course testing.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Define agile project management frameworks, processes, and methodologies, and understand the agile mindset and value-driven delivery.
Apply agile tools and techniques in alignment with Project Management Institute (PMI) standards.
Engage agile project stakeholders through active dialogue to identify potential issues, risks, and defects.
Explain the roles and responsibilities of team members and build a high-performance agile team.
Implement adaptive planning to help the team respond effectively to changes.
Incorporate continuous improvement into agile projects through process analysis and tailoring.
Prepare for and apply to take the PMI-ACP Exam.

items.text: Core principles of agile project management
The Agile Manifesto and its four values
Comparing traditional and agile project management
High-level planning tools (affinity estimating, t-shirt sizing)
Managing cycle time, Work In Progress (WIP), and throughput
